empty: No session board source is configured yet.
warning.title: Before you turn on {name}
warning.ban: Automated browsing on {name} can get your account restricted or banned, and some platforms forbid it in their terms. The risk is yours.
warning.cookies.macos_keychain: The session's cookies live in a dedicated browser profile that Chrome encrypts with the macOS Keychain — not with Boba's database encryption.
warning.cookies.windows_dpapi: The session's cookies live in a dedicated browser profile that Chrome encrypts with Windows DPAPI — not with Boba's database encryption.
warning.cookies.linux_keyring: The session's cookies live in a dedicated browser profile that Chrome encrypts with your login keyring — not with Boba's database encryption.
warning.cookies.linux_weak: The session's cookies live in a dedicated browser profile. No keyring is available on this machine, so Chrome can only protect them with weaker, machine-local encryption — not Boba's database encryption.
warning.retention: Boba keeps this session until you choose “Sign out / clear session” or Reset everything.
warning.pacing: Boba reads slowly and at a human-like pace. It never creates accounts and never solves CAPTCHAs: a challenge pauses the source and notifies you.
warning.read: I have read and understand this warning.
warning.weak_ack: I understand these cookies are protected only weakly on this machine.
error.load: The session settings could not be loaded.
error.save: That change could not be saved.
privacy.title: Sessions
privacy.intro: Session board sources browse in their own browser profile. Sign out to delete a source's session and cookies.
privacy.retention: Cookies are kept until you sign out of this source or reset everything.
privacy.none: No session board source is keeping cookies.
privacy.cookie_protection: Chrome protects these cookies with {store} — not with Boba's database encryption.
